reviews.review: Its a great game just super unforgiving and not as polished as Dark Souls and The Surge.

So far, at about 8 hours in. There is no store that I have found. which means everything is RNG based for drops. Makes boss fights stupid hard if you get bad RNG.
I do enjoy the general gameplay, but I think boss fights are poorly designed. Especially considering the RNG need. I don't want to sit here farming xp for hours to be strong enough to do things.

I really like this game.
The game play is the same as dark soul, except that you shoot guns instead of swinging a weapon.

The targeting system work the same as dark soul, the camera work that same too,
Tons of different weapons and loots.

I like the maps, they play like in dark soul, you have to think of a strategy before rushing into a bunch of mobs.

The world is interesting, not as dark or atmospheric as dark soul, but still does a good job. 

I think most of bad reviews come from peoples with too high expectations, this game definitively does not have the same level of quality as dark soul ( probably not the same kind of budget neither), Still the game is well made, i did not encounter any major bug neither any bad performance.

I hope to see a Immortal Unchained 2 with more budget and a targeting mechanics like they did in the Surge 2 (targeting body parts).

Update : After spending more time playing the game, i still really enjoy the game, the fights are really good and challenging enough. I will update one more time once i finished the game.

This game is not perfect but it is a nice version of the Souls Like series we all like, i comend the efforts off the devs to take a risk of a shooter style souls game, for what the game does it is not bad at all actually , it was a solid atempt of this style of gae, it is daman hard of a game and worth the time to buy this game when it is on sale,

Starting a new character in this game is literally a torture. I tried very hard but it just makes no sense. After 6 hours I found around 25+ weapons but even the grey trash weapons have so high stat demands I was able to try 2 of them.
At that point I got really angry downloaded a trainer and buffed my character just to be able to try different weapons.
Its all trash except Snipers. Literally the only weapon category that will get you anywhere. There is no balance trash mobs are often 10 times harder than any boss fight. You struggle your way thru the level get to the boss and kill him with a few shots before he even does anything. Often feels like the bosses have less health than bigger trash mods.
The only positive thing about this game is the level design thats what kept me going. Exploring finding new keys new locations. That part feels really good but unfortunately its the only good thing about this game.
